test_objective: Check that one can query the temporal evolution of an entity with format or options query params
keywords: Query The Temporal Evolution of An Entity With Format Or Options Query Params

test_cases.name: 021_19_01 QueryWithFormatOnly
test_cases.doc: Check that one can query the temporal evolution with format query param only
test_cases.template: Query The Temporal Evolution of An Entity With Format Or Options Query Params
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Query Temporal Representation Of Entities with Response Status Code set to 200     and
        Query Temporal Representation Of Entities with Request response body containing a list that contains Entity Temporal Elements
            compared with file '${expectation_file}'
            and using the list of entity ids define in '${temporal_entities_representation_ids}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities'
        method set to 'GET'
        Query Temporal Representation of Entities and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to '${types}' and
    Query Parameter: options set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: format set to 'temporalValues' and
    Query Parameter: aggrMethods set to '${aggr_methods}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://easy-global-market.github.io/ngsild-api-data-models/ngsildTestSuite/ngsildTestSuiteV1.8-compound.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: timerel set to 'after' and
    Query Parameter: timeAt set to '2020-01-01T12:03:00Z'
}
